Name: Stawdew Vawwey - UwU Text Overhaul
Author: Morkmorked
Description:
Turns Stardew Valley into Stawdew Vawwey by uwufying dialogue, mail, item descriptions, events, and UI text.

It targets NPC dialogue, mail, event text, item/object descriptions, and UI strings, while preserving common Stardew formatting tokens, placeholders, player-name markers, and dialogue commands.

[size=5]Features:[/size]
- Uwufies dialogue, mail, events, item descriptions, and UI strings.
- Configurable intensity: Light, Medium, or Maximum.
- Does not edit vanilla game files.
- Includes SMAPI console commands for quick changes.

[size=5]Requirements:[/size]
- Stardew Valley
- SMAPI 4.0.0 or newer

[size=5]Manual installation:[/size]
1. Install SMAPI.
2. Download the mod zip.
3. Extract the StawdewVawwey folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
4. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.

[size=5]Vortex installation:[/size]
1. Install SMAPI first.
2. Use Vortex to download/install the mod.
3. Make sure the mod is enabled.
4. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.

[size=4]Config options include:[/size]
- Enabled
- Intensity
- AffectDialogue
- AffectEvents
- AffectMail
- AffectObjectsAndItems
- AffectUiStrings
- ExtraSuffixChance
- ProtectFormattingTokens

[size=4]Console commands:[/size]
stawdew_uwu status
stawdew_uwu toggle
stawdew_uwu reload
stawdew_uwu intensity Light
stawdew_uwu intensity Medium
stawdew_uwu intensity Maximum

[size=4]Known limits:[/size]
This mod catches most text loaded through Stardew’s content pipeline. Text generated directly by game code or another SMAPI mod may not be affected.
